sample.question:
The jewel board should be invariant under every 90-degree clockwise rotation about its center. Coordinates are zero-based (row,column) from the top-left. A ? is a missing tile and must be restored.
Which jewel must replace the ? at (3, 5) to restore its rotational orbit?
A. Sapphire
B. Ruby
C. Amber
D. Jade
E. Violet
F. Coral
sample.analysis: The other cells in this orbit are [(5, 3), (3, 1), (1, 3)]. Their intended shared color is Sapphire; therefore the missing cell must also be Sapphire. The answer is A.
